title: Healthcare World-Model Extraction Schema
global_rules: Record what the paper DEMONSTRATES with evidence in methods/results; author claims go only in the dedicated "claimed" or synthesis columns.
Never infer unreported details: use "Not reported"; use "Not applicable" when a concept cannot apply.
Categorical columns must use exactly one value from allowed_values unless the column is marked multi-value (separate with ";").
Capability level (L0–L4) and Clinical Readiness Stage (R0–R8) are independent axes.
Action conditioning is not causal identification; fill causality columns from explicit causal methods/assumptions only.
Numbers must be copied from the paper with units; do not compute or estimate.

columns.name: Paper ID
columns.definition: Local ID (001–099, B001–B106, A01–A20) or new ID
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Always fill. Use the local file prefix (001–099, B001–B106, A01–A20); new papers get the next free ID.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Title
columns.definition: Full title as in the PDF (not the file name)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Exact title as printed on the first page of the PDF version read (not the file name or a catalogue title).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Authors
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Author byline of the PDF version read. Do not copy from search engines if it differs from the PDF.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Year
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Year printed on the version read (journal issue, conference year or preprint version date).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Venue / Journal
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Journal/conference/preprint server stated on the PDF or its official landing page.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Publication status
columns.definition: Peer review status of the version read
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Fill from the PDF header/footer or official landing page. Preprint unless a peer-reviewed venue is explicitly shown.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: DOI / URL
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: DOI printed in the paper or its official landing page; otherwise the canonical arXiv/publisher URL.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Source folder
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Folder in which the PDF actually sits.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Local file name
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Exact PDF file name on disk.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Paper type
allowed_values: Primary method – application/adaptation of existing WM
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Classify from the abstract + methods: "Primary method" only if the paper proposes/trains/evaluates a model; "Survey/review" only if it synthesises others' work; "Out of scope" when there is no temporal/action modelling in healthcare.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Overlap / duplicate flag
columns.definition: Same study/lineage as another paper? Give IDs (e.g., 009/060; 089/094; GAS/GASv2)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Fill only when two papers share authors AND the same model/cohort/results, or when the paper states it extends a prior version. Cite the paired IDs.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Final Included
columns.definition: Inclusion decision for the WM review
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: "Include – core" requires evidence of a state + learned/hybrid temporal transition in a health setting (KB §1.3, §1.4). Component/supporting if it supplies a WM part (encoder, UQ, causal estimator, audit). Otherwise Exclude.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Exclusion Reason
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Required only when Final Included = Exclude; choose the single primary reason.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Clinical Domain
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Specialty explicitly targeted by the paper's data/task (not generic claims of applicability).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Disease / condition
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Condition(s) named in the dataset/cohort description.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Care setting
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Setting explicitly stated or unambiguously implied by the data (e.g., MIMIC → ICU).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Scale of the modelled world
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Level at which the STATE is defined in the methods (organ voxels, whole-patient physiology, EHR trajectory, surgical scene, hospital operations, population).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Primary Healthcare Task
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Task that the main experiments evaluate (not every application listed in the discussion).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Clinical question answered
columns.definition: Phrase as a question, e.g., "How will this tumour evolve under regimen A vs B?"
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Must be traceable to the evaluated output (e.g., forecasted MRI under treatment). Do not phrase questions the experiments do not answer.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Target population
columns.definition: Inclusion criteria / population (age, disease stage, cohort)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Inclusion criteria / cohort characteristics stated in methods. "Not reported" if only dataset name is given.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Intended user
columns.definition: Clinician, sonographer, surgeon, robot, researcher, policy-maker, patient
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only if the paper states who would use the system; otherwise "Not reported".
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Decision supported
columns.definition: Which real decision the outputs inform
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only a decision the outputs are explicitly designed or evaluated to inform.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Self-described label
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Term the authors use in title/abstract for their system.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: World-model family
allowed_values: F2 EHR / ICU event & latent patient dynamics
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Assign using KB §16.1 based on state + action + dynamics actually implemented.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: General WM paradigm
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Assign using KB §7 based on the training objective and state type in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Capability level (L0–L4)
columns.definition: Highest level demonstrated with evidence (not claimed)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Highest level SUPPORTED BY RESULTS: L1 needs reported forecasts of future state; L2 needs results conditioned on specified actions; L3 needs reported comparison of rollouts under ≥2 alternative action sequences for the same patient/scene; L4 needs an optimiser/policy using the WM with reported decision/control results. L0 if only representation quality is evaluated.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Capability level claimed by authors
columns.definition: Level the authors claim, if higher than demonstrated
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Level implied by the authors' claims in abstract/conclusion, even if not fully evaluated.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Has state (Y/N)
columns.definition: Maintains an explicit or latent state
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if methods define a state/latent/belief variable that persists across time steps.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Has temporal transition (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if a model maps state at t to state at t+Δ (learned, mechanistic or hybrid).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Action-conditioned (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if actions/interventions are an explicit input to the transition in the equations/architecture.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Multi-step rollout (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if results report predictions beyond one step produced by feeding predictions back (or continuous-time integration over a horizon).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Uses rollouts for decisions (Y/N)
columns.definition: Rollouts feed a planner, comparison or policy
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if simulated trajectories are used to select/rank/learn actions in the experiments.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Complete perception–dynamics–planning loop (Y/N)
columns.definition: All six canonical components present and connected
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if encoder, state, action-conditioned transition and planner/policy are all implemented and jointly evaluated.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Composition pattern
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: From the architecture figure/methods: how modules hand off (KB §15.3).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Input Modality and Type of Data
columns.definition: All modalities, separated by ";" (EHR codes; labs/vitals; notes; X-ray/CT/MRI; ultrasound; video; ECG/EEG; wearables/CGM; omics; robot kinematics; eye-tracking; aggregate)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: List every modality actually fed to the model in experiments (not those mentioned as future work).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Encoder architecture
columns.definition: e.g., ViT, 3D CNN, Transformer, LLM-as-encoder, GNN
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Network named in methods for each modality.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Pretrained / foundation encoder used
columns.definition: Name of reused foundation model (e.g., V-JEPA 2.1, Cosmos, LLaMA, CT-FM) or None
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only if a named pretrained model/checkpoint is reused; give its name.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Encoder pretraining objective
columns.definition: Reconstruction / MAE; latent prediction (JEPA); contrastive; next-token; none
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Loss stated in methods for encoder pretraining.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Multimodal fusion strategy
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Fusion mechanism described in methods; "Not applicable" for single-modality models.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Missing-modality / missing-data handling
columns.definition: Availability masks, imputation, masking, belief update only on observation
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Explicit mechanism in methods (masks, imputation, belief updates). "Not reported" if missingness is not discussed.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Irregular sampling handled (Y/N)
columns.definition: Native timestamps / Δt / continuous time used
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if the model ingests real time gaps (Δt/timestamps) or continuous time; resampling to a grid alone = No.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Observation process modelled (Y/N)
columns.definition: Measurement timing, availability, informative missingness or acquisition modelled explicitly
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if measurement timing/availability/intensity is modelled or used as input (not merely imputed away).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Observation-clock audit (EndoClock regime)
columns.definition: Where task evidence survives: sampled values / grid-cell update pattern / native timing / external channel / not assessed
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Fill only if the paper analyses whether temporal resampling preserves task evidence; otherwise "Not assessed".
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: State representation type
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Form of the state in methods (KB §6 DA1).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: State dimensionality
columns.definition: Latent size or number of variables
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Number stated in methods/appendix; else "Not reported".
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Belief / filtering mechanism
columns.definition: How the state is updated from observations (RSSM posterior, Kalman-like filter, propagate–correct, hourly assimilation)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Explicit update rule combining prior prediction with new observations; "None" if state is recomputed from scratch.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Unified / reusable state across tasks (Y/N)
columns.definition: Same state serves multiple readouts (typed decoders)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if one shared state feeds ≥2 different readouts/tasks in experiments.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: State sufficiency tested (Y/N)
columns.definition: Ablations showing state contains transition determinants
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if ablations remove/alter state components (history, treatment, stage) and report effect on predictions.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Personalisation mechanism
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Mechanism in methods by which individual data change the forecast.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Personalisation audit (P³ / history swap)
columns.definition: Patient / Place / Prior or withhold/swap controls; result
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Fill only if experiments withhold/swap/shuffle patient history or compare to population-average forecasts; report result.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Online updating / assimilation (Y/N)
columns.definition: State updated with new data without retraining (digital-twin behaviour)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if the paper shows forecasts updated from new observations at inference without retraining.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: State interpretability
columns.definition: Explicit variables, scene graphs, probes, none
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only interpretability evidence shown (explicit variables, probing, visualisations).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: State consistency mechanism
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Loss/constraint/memory explicitly targeting identity/anatomy persistence across rollouts.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Action type
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Class of actions present in the model input (KB §16.3 lesson 3).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Action representation
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Encoding of actions in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Action attributes specified
columns.definition: Which of: units, dose, route, timing, duration, co-interventions, valid ranges
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: List only attributes actually encoded (units, dose, route, timing, duration, co-interventions, ranges).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Treatment bundles handled (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if co-occurring intervention components are modelled/edited as a set.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Action constraints / contraindications
columns.definition: Rules, valid ranges, support checks applied to actions
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Explicit rules/ranges/support checks applied to candidate actions in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Observation-changing vs physiology-changing actions separated (Y/N)
columns.definition: Acquisition actions kept distinct from treatment actions
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if the action space distinguishes acquisition/inquiry actions from treatment actions.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Action grounding
columns.definition: For learned latent actions: how they map to executable commands
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: For latent/learned actions only: how mapped to executable commands and whether evaluated.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Model(s) name
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Name given by authors; "Unnamed" if none.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Dynamics backbone
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Architecture of the transition function in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Time representation
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: How time is represented in the transition (KB §5 P9).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Time scale & step size
columns.definition: e.g., hourly, per visit, per frame (30 fps), seconds
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Step/resolution stated in data processing section.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Stochastic transitions (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if transitions output a distribution or are sampled.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Structural / mechanistic priors
columns.definition: Physics, ODE/PDE, PK/PD, sign constraints, conservation, symbolic rules, object-centric
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only priors encoded in model/loss (equations, constraints, rules).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Memory mechanism
columns.definition: How history beyond current state is retained
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Mechanism retaining history in the transition.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: History / context length
columns.definition: Steps, visits or time span conditioned on
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Numeric context length or span in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Temporal abstraction / hierarchy
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only explicit multi-timescale/hierarchical modules.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Multiple dynamics backends behind common contract (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if ≥2 dynamics models are interchangeable or combined behind one interface.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Observation decoder / generated outputs
columns.definition: What is generated (images, video, ECG, events, labs, none)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Outputs generated from the state in experiments.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Task readout heads
columns.definition: Typed clinical readouts (survival, pCR, mortality, EF, BCVA ...)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Clinical heads trained/evaluated on the state.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Reward / value / cost model
columns.definition: Reward, value, utility or cost definitions
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Explicit reward/value/cost definition; "None" otherwise.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Training objective(s)
columns.definition: Reconstruction; latent prediction; next-token; diffusion/flow; multi-step/overshooting; reward/value; causal balancing; physics residual; RL
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Losses written in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Multi-step training loss (Y/N)
columns.definition: Trained on k-step predictions or rollouts
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if the loss includes k>1-step predictions or rollouts.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Self-supervised pretraining scale
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Pretraining data size stated (patients/records/hours/images).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Model(s) size or size range
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Parameter count stated in paper/appendix/model card; do not estimate.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Open/Closed Models
columns.definition: Weights open or closed (incl. any LLM/foundation components)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Based on stated release of weights (and openness of any foundation model used).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Training compute reported
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Hardware/time stated; else "Not reported".
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Inference latency / real-time capability
columns.definition: Seconds per step/action; streaming; distillation used
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Measured latency/throughput reported in results.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Rollout mode
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: How multi-step predictions are produced in evaluation.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Maximum horizon evaluated
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Longest horizon in reported results (with units).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Effective / validated horizon
columns.definition: Horizon at which error stays within stated tolerance
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Only if the paper reports the horizon at which error stays within a stated tolerance or degrades past a threshold.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Compounding error measured (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if error-versus-horizon is reported.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Number of sampled futures / distributional output
columns.definition: Point forecast vs N samples / distribution
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Samples/distribution reported in results.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Planning
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Planner/policy type used in experiments (KB §9).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Planning horizon
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Planner horizon stated in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Closed-loop re-planning (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if the planner re-plans after new observations in evaluation.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Objective / utility & constraints
columns.definition: What is optimised and under which constraints/preferences
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Objective function and constraints stated in methods.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" (or "Not applicable" when the concept cannot apply).

columns.name: Uncertainty used in planning (Y/N)
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if uncertainty enters the planning objective or action filter.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Model-exploitation tested (Y/N)
columns.definition: Checks that planner does not exploit model error
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if experiments test whether planned actions exploit model error (e.g., held-out simulator, real execution, support checks).
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).

columns.name: Abstention / deferral (Y/N)
columns.definition: System can abstain or defer when unsupported/uncertain
columns.fill_only_if_paper_contains: Yes only if the system can output "abstain/defer/escalate" and this is described or evaluated.
columns.value_if_evidence_absent: "Not reported" if the paper is silent; "Not applicable" if the concept cannot apply (e.g., no planner).
